PreToolUse.command: node -e "const path=require('path'); const cfg=require('./scripts/hooks/protected-paths.json'); const p=process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_TARGET||''; const n=path.normalize(p).replace(/\\/g,'/'); const parts=n.split('/').filter(Boolean); const b=parts[parts.length-1]||''; const r=cfg.protectedBasenamePatterns.map(s=>new RegExp(s)); const segs=cfg.protectedPathSegments||[]; if(segs.some(s=>parts.includes(s))||r.some(x=>x.test(b))){ console.error('Blocked edit to protected path: '+p); process.exit(2);} process.exit(0);"

PostToolUse.command: node -e "const {spawnSync}=require('child_process'); const path=require('path'); const f=process.env.CLAUDE_TOOL_TARGET||''; if(!f) process.exit(0); const ext=path.extname(f); const map={'.ts':['npx','-y','prettier','--write',f],'.js':['npx','-y','prettier','--write',f],'.py':['black',f],'.go':['gofmt','-w',f],'.rs':['rustfmt',f]}; const cmd=map[ext]; if(!cmd) process.exit(0); const r=spawnSync(cmd[0],cmd.slice(1),{stdio:'inherit'}); process.exit(r.status ?? 1);"

SessionStart.command: echo "Use the project's package manager. Run /verify before claiming completion. Never edit protected files."
